TextBlock.Text: THEATRE Jolo, Sulu
DATE 19 October 2028 · 0930 local
SIDE Philippine Navy
WINDOW 110 min, closes at 165
Tarlac class landing platform dock. Photo: U.S. Navy photo by Mass Communication Specialist 1st Class Daniel B... · CC BY-SA 4.0 · cropped

OFF JOLO, 0930. Marine Battalion Landing Team 7 went ashore east of Jolo town two days ago to clear the coast road. It is pinned below the ridge above Patikul. The Meridian network has armed the ridge: two drone launch rails, two gun trucks and an air-defence vehicle that drove the Air Force's helicopters off yesterday afternoon.

The battalion has asked for naval gunfire. Your ships are twenty-five miles north of the coast. Close to gun range and destroy at least three of the five positions. The Marines' fire control party has them plotted and they are on your map.

The launch rails can put a drone on a ship as easily as on the Marines, and Meridian keeps a fast attack craft at Basilan. Nothing you fire today comes back except from your own supply ship. Bancas are working the coast.
Naval Forces West; Marine Battalion Landing Team 7 ashore
COMMANDER'S INTENT

Take the ridge's weapons off the Marines. Three of the five positions destroyed lets the battalion move. The guns are the right tool: they reach, and a gun round is the cheapest thing a supply ship carries. Keep enough back for the Meridian boat that will come out of Basilan when it hears the firing.
• Destroy three of the five positions on the ridge
• Keep the lead ship afloat
• Sink the Meridian boat if it comes out
• Harm no banca

Your task group, its helicopter and any FA-50s the Air Force has released, out of Zamboanga. Ashore, on the ridge: two drone launch rails, two gun trucks, a Sosna air-defence vehicle. At sea: one Meridian fast attack craft at Basilan. Neutral: bancas.

The planned window is 110 minutes. At that minute Command signals that you are behind schedule and holds the line for about 55 minutes more; the operation is closed at 165 minutes and the main task will be recorded as failed.
RULES OF ENGAGEMENT
All designated neutral contacts are protected. A protected neutral loss cancels the operation. Identify before you shoot.
